text: {"label": "Serious Mental Illness and Psychiatric Care","definition": "Interventions and service models for people with psychiatric conditions, especially schizophrenia, psychosis and severe mental illness, in inpatient, outpatient, school, workplace and integrated mental health settings.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centres on severe psychiatric disorders and mental health service settings, not depression and anxiety treatment, general intensive behavioral intervention programs, or clinical behavior analysis as a field."}
